purpose: Preregistered recombination of two independently discovered near-neutral clues: sweep->MSS->OB-midpoint timing from 17H and structure-aligned FVG context from 17E. Test whether FVG confirmation improves the same frozen 30-second entry economics without modifying 17H C02.

source_basis.logic: M1 sweep->MSS->OB midpoint retest ordinary-pass, -$0.03 net delta; no strong pass.
M5 BOS+FVG retest ordinary-pass, -$0.05 net delta; no strong pass.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — Fair Value Gap Strategy with BOS Confirmation
source_basis.logic: Classic three-candle FVG is contextualized by confirmed structure rather than traded alone.

source_basis.source: TradingView open source — MU indicator ICT
source_basis.logic: Reconstructible sweep, MSS, FVG and OB concepts are combined as confluence.

source_basis.source: MetaQuotes — Inverse Fair Value Gap Trading Strategy
source_basis.logic: FVG is a three-candle price imbalance with state that can later be respected or invalidated.

frozen_base: Exact 17H C02 lifecycle: M1 width-2 swing sweep -> frozen opposite-swing MSS -> last opposite-colour OB -> first OB body interaction must reach midpoint and close on shift-direction side.

fvg_semantics.bullish: completed bar i forms bullish FVG when low[i] > high[i-2]; zone [high[i-2], low[i]]
fvg_semantics.bearish: completed bar i forms bearish FVG when high[i] < low[i-2]; zone [high[i], low[i-2]]
fvg_semantics.creation: completed bars only; FVG visible at bar i close
fvg_semantics.unmitigated: bullish FVG remains active until a later completed bar low <= lower edge; bearish remains active until later completed bar high >= upper edge
fvg_semantics.direction: only FVGs matching the SMOR shift direction count
fvg_semantics.causality: FVG must be created after the sweep and no later than the OB-retest decision bar

R037-SFOC-C01_ANY_ACTIVE_FVG.rule: At SMOR midpoint retest, at least one same-direction unmitigated M1 FVG created since the sweep must remain active.

R037-SFOC-C02_MSS_OR_NEXT_FVG.rule: As C01, and at least one qualifying FVG must have been created on the MSS bar or the immediately following completed bar.

R037-SFOC-C03_OB_FVG_OVERLAP.rule: As C01, and at least one qualifying active FVG zone must geometrically overlap the OB body zone.

R037-SFOC-C04_RETEST_TOUCHES_FVG.rule: As C01, and the first OB-midpoint retest bar must also intersect at least one qualifying active same-direction FVG zone.

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
